headline: Solar energy is free, abundant, and available everywhere—the original and ultimate power source
universal_truth: The best resources are often freely available and overlooked; abundance can hide in plain sight
fun_facts: More solar energy hits Earth in one hour than humanity uses in an entire year
Solar panel costs have dropped 99% since 1976—from $100/watt to under $1/watt
Almost all energy on Earth comes from the sun—even fossil fuels are ancient stored solar energy
discussion_questions: What abundant resources are you overlooking?
What's freely available that you're paying for elsewhere?
How do you tap into natural flows of energy and resources?

hook.title: Welcome
hook.script: Every day, the sun delivers more energy to Earth than all fossil fuels we've ever burned. It's been doing this for 4.5 billion years and will continue for another 5 billion. Free, clean, abundant power—right there in the sky.

options.text: I want to learn something new
options.response: Perfect. Curiosity is the first step to understanding. Let's explore this together.
That curiosity is exactly what we need. Let's dive in and discover something amazing.

cliff.title: The Question
cliff.script: Solar energy has always been abundant, yet we've mostly ignored it for fossil fuels. What does this reveal about how we see resources?

options.text: We valued concentrated, storable energy over diffuse, flow energy—abundance seemed less valuable than scarcity; ease of extraction trumped sustainability
options.response: Yes. Oil is energy-dense, storable, transportable. Solar is diffuse, requires capture, doesn't store easily. We optimized for convenience over sustainability. But technology changes what's convenient.

options.text: Solar technology wasn't developed until recently
options.response: Technology matters, but the sun has always been usable—passive solar, drying, heating...

q1.title: Abundance Hiding in Plain Sight
q1.script: Solar energy is so abundant we don't notice it. Like air, its ubiquity makes it invisible. The most valuable resources are sometimes the ones we overlook because they're everywhere.
q1.prompt: What's your first impression of "Abundance Hiding in Plain Sight"?

options.text: This confirms what I already knew
options.response: Great foundation! Now let's build on that knowledge with something you might not expect...
Perfect starting point! This insight will connect to even more surprising facts ahead.

q2.title: Capture Technology
q2.script: Solar required technology to become useful for electricity. But costs dropped 99% in 40 years. What seemed impractical became dominant. Technology unlocks previously inaccessible abundance.
q2.prompt: How does this connect to what you already know?

options.response: Exactly. These connections are how knowledge becomes understanding.

options.text: I need to think about this more
options.response: That's a good instinct. Deep understanding takes time. The next fact will help clarify.

q3.title: Personal Abundance
q3.script: What abundant resources are you overlooking? Free information, available relationships, untapped skills, natural energy. Sometimes the solution is accessing what's already there, not acquiring something new.
q3.prompt: What surprises you most about this?

options.text: I never thought about it this way
options.response: That shift in perspective is exactly the point. New angles reveal new truths.
That's learning in action. When understanding shifts, you're really getting it.

wisdom.title: Today's Wisdom
wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: The best resources are often freely available and overlooked. Abundance can hide in plain sight. Look for what's already there.
wisdom.prompt: What resonates most with you today?

options.response: That central truth will stay with you. Let it guide your thinking.
Application is where knowledge becomes wisdom. That's the real learning.

outro.title: See You Tomorrow
outro.script: That's Day 273—the last day of September! Tomorrow, October begins with how leaves feed the world. Until then, notice the abundant resources around you.
outro.prompt: Before you go—what will you take from today?

options.response: Reflection deepens learning. Let these ideas simmer in your mind.
Teaching others is the best way to learn. You've already begun the ripple.

growTrack.title: Hidden Abundance Check - What's Freely Available?
growTrack.activity: What resources are abundant around you but overlooked? Free learning resources, available mentorship, natural energy (walking, sunlight), public facilities? Sometimes wealth comes from accessing what's already there, not acquiring more.
